verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents several APIs (Harvest, Job Board, Assessment, Candidate Ingestion), so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. However, no evidence shows an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. JSON API responses are not a spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
